g.text: As dawn breaks over the misty moors, you find yourself standing at the edge of a
dense forest, the air filled with the scent of damp earth and undergrowth. The
path before you winds through twisted trees and underbrush, leading into an
unknown thicket. To your left stands an old, gnarled oak, its branches reaching
out as if inviting you to seek shelter beneath its boughs.
Thrain: I draw my sword and cautiously step deeper into the ruins
With a deep breath, you grip your longsword tightly as you push aside the heavy
curtain of leaves and brush. The path narrows, leading you into a dimly lit
clearing where ancient stone walls still stand, hinting at forgotten rituals and
secrets. The air is thick with a sense of danger, and you can hear faint
